listing.detail: A free desktop cockpit for Claude Code: sessions with a persona and a mission, a scheduler that waits out your token limit, and every setting in one window.
listing.audience: Developers who run Claude Code sessions every day.
talkingPoints: Free desktop app for managing Claude Code CLI sessions.
Each session gets a persona and a mission.
Has a scheduler that waits out your token limit and resumes work.
Ships with a free Field Manual.
listing.callToAction: Try it: run npx claude-code-session-manager@latest, or grab the installer from GitHub Releases.
avoidClaims: It is a hosted SaaS or cloud service. It is a local desktop app; sessions and files stay on the user's machine.
It is made, endorsed or supported by Anthropic. It is an independent, single-author open-source project.
It includes Claude access or replaces a Claude plan. Users need Claude Code installed and signed in with their own account.
It has a paid, pro or trial tier. The app and the Field Manual are both free (MIT).
It is a team or enterprise product with support or an SLA.
